name: JPYdf
oneLiner: JPYdf is a yen-targeted Liquity v2 fork on Ethereum, borrowed against wstETH or USDC, with no yen redemption claim.
collateral: User-deposited wstETH and USDC in two isolated Liquity v2 branches, held through 18-decimal dToken wrappers that the protocol treats as 1:1 claims on the underlying while backingRatio equals 1.0. Minimum collateral ratios are 123.18% for dwstETH and 111.58% for dUSDC, with critical ratios of 141.67% and 124.50% and shutdown ratios of 110.00% and 105.00%. At Ethereum block 26504779 (November 27, 2026), the branches held 601,835.83 dUSDC and 78.92 dwstETH, putting USDC at 77.9% of collateral value ($601.8K of $772.7K) and 81.4% of branch debt. Within the upgradeable dUSDC CollateralVault, 20,041 USDC sat in the idle withdrawal buffer while 290,897 USDC principal each was deployed to Aave V3 and a Gauntlet Morpho Vault V2; all 78.92 wstETH sat idle in the dwstETH CollateralVault. Six additional branches in CollateralRegistry remain unfinalized with zero debt and collateral. DeltaForesight's corporate financing is not token collateral.
pegMechanism: Only registered BorrowerOperations and ActivePool contracts can mint JPYdf through the borrowing core (with an inactive timelocked bridgeAdmin path on JpydfToken), and users borrow JPYdf against overcollateralized troves at user-set interest rates. Undercollateralized troves are liquidated against the branch Stability Pool or redistributed to other troves in the branch. Any holder can redeem JPYdf for dToken collateral valued at ¥1 per JPYdf, less a fee of at least 0.5% plus a base rate that decays with a six-hour half-life. Chainlink JPY/USD, stETH/USD, ETH/USD, stETH/ETH and USDC/USD feeds price collateral. The yen is a value target only: JPYdf carries no yen monetary claim, no yen redemption right and no face-value buyback commitment.

notices.title: No yen redemption claim and restricted app access
notices.message: JPYdf tracks the yen as a value target only and carries no fiat yen claim or issuer buyback right. Redemptions return dTokens whose underlying USDC is largely deployed into Aave V3 and Morpho V2, where buffer depletion triggers a three-day withdrawal waiting period. The JPYdf Foundation DAO LLC web interface excludes residents of Japan, the United States, and sanctioned jurisdictions.

featuredContent.title: JPY DeFi launches on Ethereum mainnet
featuredContent.description: DeltaForesight reports the October 15 launch with wstETH and USDC branches, an app run by JPYdf Foundation DAO LLC that excludes Japanese residents, and no yen redemption right.

featuredContent.title: DeltaForesight announces development of JPYdf before mainnet
featuredContent.description: The developer describes cryptoasset and stablecoin collateral, rule-based overcollateralized issuance and liquidation, while disclaiming yen redemption rights.

featuredContent.title: DeltaForesight plans Fusion vaults after JPY DeFi mainnet
featuredContent.description: IPOR Labs is to provide vault infrastructure and technical support; chains, strategies and offering terms remain undecided.

milestones.title: Chain Defenders completes two JPYdf security reviews
milestones.description: The first review lists 1 High, 3 Medium and 7 Low findings among 21, with 10 fixed and 11 acknowledged; a follow-up enhancement review lists 2 Medium and 3 Low, with four fixed. The reports themselves were not independently reviewed by Pharos.

milestones.title: DeltaForesight announces JPYdf development before mainnet
milestones.description: The developer publishes the overcollateralized borrowing design and announces corporate J-KISS financing. Launch timing and user terms remain unannounced; the financing is not protocol backing.

milestones.title: DeltaForesight plans related vaults using Fusion by IPOR
milestones.description: Related ERC-4626 vaults are planned after JPY DeFi mainnet, subject to development, security audits and legal review. IPOR Labs provides infrastructure and technical support; token deployments and offering terms are not announced.

milestones.title: Guardian issues updated review of JPYdf-specific changes
milestones.description: The protocol reports no Critical, High or Medium findings in the reviewed scope, with 17 resolved and four acknowledged. A Guardian-hosted contest and post-launch bug bounty were still in preparation.

milestones.title: Guardian Defender bounty contest for JPYdf opens
milestones.description: JPY DeFi's documentation lists the JPYdf Bounty Contest on Guardian Defender as active, with a submission period from October 14 to November 13 2026. In-scope findings are reported on the contest page, and SDK issues go through GitHub private vulnerability reporting, which does not promise a reward.

milestones.title: JPY DeFi launches on Ethereum mainnet
milestones.description: Public launch with wstETH and USDC branches. Supply reached 91.7 million JPYdf by 08:54 UTC, with no DefiLlama or CoinGecko listing.

milestones.title: DefiLlama begins tracking JPYdf supply without a price
milestones.description: DefiLlama added JPYdf as stablecoin 448 on October 22 2026, reporting about 93.3 million JPYdf on Ethereum, matching on-chain total supply. DefiLlama carries no price for it and CoinGecko has no listing.
